leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize an AbortController instance within a Vue component's setup function
Integrate the AbortController's signal into a fetch request to enable cancellation
Configure a cleanup function in onUnmounted to abort pending fetch requests
Apply the AbortController pattern to prevent memory leaks in asynchronous operations
Construct a reactive data property to store fetched data and handle loading states
Implement error handling for aborted requests using try-catch blocks
Manipulate component state to reflect cancellation and cleanup outcomes
